# SERVE

> SERVE is a registered charity (number 1043321) based in Rushden, Northamptonshire, England. For over 40 years it has provided care and support to older people, adults with disabilities and their carers, helping them to live independently in their own homes. SERVE is registered with the Care Quality Commission (CQC) and won Best Homecare Team, East Midlands at the Great British Care Awards 2024.

Key facts:

- Name: SERVE (also written "Serve")
- Type: registered charity in England and Wales, number 1043321; company number 2951827
- Area served: Northamptonshire, including Rushden, Higham Ferrers, Wellingborough, Kettering and surrounding areas. The befriending service is countywide.
- Telephone: 01933 315555 (Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm)
- Email: info@serve.org.uk
- Head office: 8 West Street, Rushden, Northamptonshire, NN10 0RT
- Day centre: The Ron Manning Day and Activity Centre, 76 Upper Kings Avenue, Higham Ferrers, Northamptonshire, NN10 8JZ
- Regulator: Care Quality Commission, inspection report at https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-2165219210
- Website: https://serve.org.uk

## Services

- [All services](https://serve.org.uk/services/): Overview of every care and community service SERVE provides
- [Personal and domestic care](https://serve.org.uk/services/personal-care/): CQC registered care in the person's own home, including help with washing, dressing, mobility and medication support
- [Home Help Service](https://serve.org.uk/services/home-help/): Light housework, meal preparation, prescription collection, errands and companionship
- [House to Home](https://serve.org.uk/services/house-to-home/): Specialist deep cleaning, decluttering and hoarding support to create a safe, healthy and comfortable home
- [Activities at Home](https://serve.org.uk/services/activities-at-home/): One-to-one companionship and activity-based support at home
- [Countywide Befriending](https://serve.org.uk/services/befriending/): Free regular visits and phone calls from trained, DBS checked volunteers for adults aged 65 and over who are lonely or isolated
- [Day Care Centre](https://serve.org.uk/services/day-care/): Social activities, nutritious meals and professional care at the Ron Manning Day and Activity Centre in Higham Ferrers
- [Community Transport](https://serve.org.uk/services/transport/): Door-to-door, wheelchair accessible transport for medical appointments, shopping trips and essential journeys
- [Community Services](https://serve.org.uk/services/community-services/): Hearing aid servicing, DBS checks and community events
